description: Card-source-verified Skill2 effects connected to the FM1 offline combat engine. This catalog is not a blanket claim that all cards with a similar Skill2 label are verified; execution requires each card mapping to carry source_card_verified, card_source authority, and source-card-rule-implemented.

sourcePriority: per-card source text and source URL
mappingGate: source Skill2 text matches the rule's canonical name
sourcePolicy.failClosed: Unmapped, candidate-only, community-only, or mismatched Skill2 metadata must not execute.

rules.name: 기선제압
rules.test: source Skill2 Tactical Initiative reduces incoming damage by one at equal or lower attacker level

rules.name: 헌신방어
rules.target: next friendly unit in field order after destroyed slot
rules.test: source Skill2 Devoted Defense buffs the next friendly field unit when the owner is destroyed

rules.name: 격노
rules.test: source Skill2 Wrath converts actual HP lost while defending into immediate AP

rules.name: 홀리오오라
rules.test: source Skill2 Holy Aura prevents damage when attacker AP is at or below half of defender DP plus HP

rules.name: 얼라이디펜스

effect.amount: count(other friendly field units with same affiliation)

rules.test: source Skill2 Alliance Defense reduces damage by each other field unit with the same affiliation

rules.name: 레이셜디펜스

effect.amount: count(other friendly field units with same race)

rules.test: source Skill2 Racial Defense reduces damage by each other field unit with the same race

rules.name: 강한헌신방어
rules.test: source Skill2 Strong Devoted Defense buffs every surviving friendly field unit when destroyed

rules.name: 프레셔
rules.test: source Skill2 Pressure reduces damage by half the number of empty friendly field slots, rounded down

verification.implementation: The 8 handlers and their targeted test cases exist in FM-OFFLINE; verify the current Actions JS test job before promoting or widening mappings.
verification.notIncluded: Skill2 enum labels outside these 8; similarly named or community candidate effects; duration or resolution assumptions without card-specific evidence.
verification.nextWork: Attach source card IDs, source URLs, exact Skill2 original strings, and effect source-text excerpts to each mapped card row; broaden mappings only after per-card source and regression tests.
